posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked:
Won on Tempest's third turn. Pretty much the perfect environment plays for me - it led off with Phosphorescent Chamber and the second one was Pillars of Hercules. Since I had Blade flipped on AZ's second turn, I just left Pillars of Hercules out and went to town.

Also had a good draw off Blade's deck - his first two turns were both Hasten Doom into one target into Slash and Burn. The second S&B hit Absolute Zero for 7, which I gladly sent back at Blade for 8 thanks to the Transducer.

Only losing 1 Ongoing/Equipment against Mad Bomber Blade is pretty much the dream scenario, I can't remember the last time I did that well.

posts.name: Kratos13
posts.cooked: Took me three tries.  Similar stories as others with bad draws for the first two games. Third wasn't looking well either - everyone incap except Fanatic. She Redeemed three to four times a round with Phosphorescent Chamber so that was actually 6-8HP healing per round until she finally drew Wrathful Retribution about 6th from the bottom of the deck. Baron had 22HP, Fanatic down to 1 after he start of turn zaps her, so I'm thinking awesome, 30pt Wrath. Then Hasten Doom, Fanatic resurrects to 10HP with Aegis.  Now she only does 21-2=19 leaving him with 3 HP.  Can you guess who saved the day? Yes, hooray for the Kraken!

posts.name: Yoshi348
posts.cooked: Mint, but a bit of a strange one. Tempest went down early thanks to a Kraken with no real way to take it out. I thought I had mostly stabilized midgame, after the flip (which did wipe a lot of cards) and with a Phosphorescent Chamber out, but some bad luck with multiple Hasten Doom/Price of Victory shenanigans into a rather devestating Slash and Burn left AZ the last one standing. I thought for sure I was a goner, as the the trash was already pretty full and I only had 9 health or so, but then I just kind of drew the perfect cards to set him up immediately, and it turns out that a set up AZ with three Thermal Shockwave power plays a round and damage and healing buffs is kind of stupid. Like, tank 10+ damage a turn and still be at full health when you started badly injured stupid. The environment decided to be really nice to me too, giving me targets to hit to power bigger Thermal Shockwaves and letting the Kraken out once Blade was lower than I was.

posts.name: scifantasy
posts.cooked:
I actually thought of some other advice.

Omni-Cannon is a trap. With no Ammo Drop draws, you’re at a card disadvantage unless you spend a long time in Recharge.

In my experience Baron Blade (any version) is not a villain you slow-play. Hit him hard and fast, don’t wait to be all set up. (See above re spending a long time in Recharge, and thus why the Cannon is a trap.)

Freedom Six Tempest just doesn’t work for me. I ignored his power all game. But if you’re desperate for Ongoing or Environment destruction, it might pay off. I guess.

posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
Mint, but a close one - only Bunker (5hp) and AZ (3hp) left standing.

GI Bunker kept busting holes in Blade's armor while Fanatic and Tempest did most of the damage.  Unfortunately, that damage was mostly through Sacrosanct Martyr and Localized Hurricane, which meant that they were taking hits fast too.  The team flipped Blade pretty quickly, but then two krakens came out back to back (!) and wiped out Helena and M'kk.  Things were looking bad, but Blade's Slash and Burn hit AZ for just enough fire damage for him to turn a Coolant Blast into the difference maker in the game.

Weirdly, random draw gave Blade almost nothing but his one-shots for the entire game so I didn't have to deal with the annyoing ongoings or early boosts to his death ray.  Instead I just had a crazy damage race with multiple Slash and Burns, Devious Disruptions, and Hasten Dooms.
